ar.title: الخرشوف المحشو

steps.n1: يحشى الخرشوف بالعصاج ويرص في إناء ثم تصب عليه الدمعة.
steps.n2: يغطى الإناء ويطهى على درجة حرارة هادئة، أو يرص في صينية ويدخل الفرن ويغطى حتى النضج.
steps.n3: يمكن تغطية الخرشوف بطبقة من الباشاميل في حالة طهوه في الفرن.

en.title: Artichokes Stuffed with Assag in

steps.n1: Stuff the artichokes with the minced meat sauce, arrange them in a pot, and pour the dam'a sauce over them.
steps.n2: Cover the pot and cook over low heat, or arrange them in a baking dish and place in the oven, covered, until cooked through.
steps.n3: You may top the artichokes with a layer of béchamel sauce if cooking them in the oven.

legacySteps: Stuff the artichokes with the minced meat sauce, arrange them in a pot, and pour the dam'a sauce over them.
Cover the pot and cook over low heat, or arrange them in a baking dish and place in the oven, covered, until cooked through.
You may top the artichokes with a layer of béchamel sauce if cooking them in the oven.
